title: Taiwan benchmark Taiex rises to record intraday high as tech stocks advance
summary: Taiwan's benchmark Taiex index reached a record intraday high, propelled by strength in the tech sector as AI-related stocks rallied globally. This reflects growing investor confidence in technology stocks and the spillover effects of Wall Street's AI-driven momentum.
content: Taiwan's benchmark Taiex rose to a record intraday high Tuesday, driven by gains in the tech sector, following an AI-driven rally on Wall Street.

zh.title: 台湾基准台指数创盘中新高，科技股走强
zh.summary: 台湾基准台指数创盘中新高，在科技板块强势的推动下，人工智能相关股票全球上涨。这反映了投资者对科技股日益增长的信心，以及华尔街人工智能驱动动力的溢出效应。

title: Here's who we know is going to the Trump-Xi dinner so far
summary: Ahead of an anticipated Trump-Xi summit, details about which Chinese business executives will attend the bilateral dinner remain sparse. The lack of disclosure reflects the sensitive nature of U.S.-China trade and diplomatic negotiations.
content: Very little is known about which Chinese business executives, if any, are expected to attend.

zh.title: 迄今为止我们知道谁将参加特朗普-习近平晚宴
zh.summary: 在预期的特朗普-习近平峰会前，关于哪些中国商业高管将出席双边晚宴的细节仍然很少。信息缺乏反映了美中贸易和外交谈判的敏感性质。

title: Tesla makes a move on Southeast Asia's largest EV market. A homegrown giant awaits
summary: Tesla established a subsidiary in Vietnam as it moves to penetrate Southeast Asia's largest electric vehicle market, currently dominated by local rival VinFast. This marks Tesla's strategic push into a rapidly growing EV sector in the region.
content: Tesla recently set up a subsidiary in Vietnam, taking a step toward a potential entry into a fast-growing EV market dominated by homegrown rival VinFast.

zh.title: 特斯拉对东南亚最大电动汽车市场采取行动。本地巨头在等待
zh.summary: 特斯拉在越南建立子公司，以进入东南亚最大的电动汽车市场，该市场目前由本地竞争对手VinFast主导。这标志着特斯拉对该地区快速增长的电动汽车市场的战略推进。

title: Stock futures are little changed after S&P 500 posts best day since early August: Live updates
summary: U.S. stock markets began the week on a strong note as the S&P 500 posted its best day since early August, driven by AI-related gains and declining yields and oil prices. Stock futures remained relatively flat in follow-up trading as investors assessed momentum.
content: The three major averages jumped to start the week's trading, catching a tailwind from a rally in AI-related stocks, as well as lower yields and oil prices.

zh.title: 股票期货在标普500指数创8月初以来最佳表现后小幅波动：实时更新
zh.summary: 美国股市以强劲表现开启本周，标普500指数创下8月初以来的最佳单日涨幅，受AI相关收益上升以及收益率和油价下降推动。在随后的交易中，股票期货保持相对平稳，投资者评估市场势头。

title: All Iranian airlines to be 'shut down' from Wednesday, Bessent tells CNBC
summary: U.S. Treasury Secretary Bessent announced that all Iranian airlines will be shut down starting Wednesday as part of intensified economic pressure on Iran. The move represents an escalation in sanctions targeting Iran's aviation sector.
content: The Treasury Secretary said that Washington was pressuring Iran "like never before"

zh.title: 美国财政部长贝森特告诉CNBC伊朗所有航空公司将从周三开始'关闭'
zh.summary: 美国财政部长贝森特宣布，从周三开始，所有伊朗航空公司将被关闭，这是加强对伊朗经济压力的一部分。此举代表针对伊朗航空部门的制裁升级。

title: Jamie Dimon says hyperscaler AI spending could hit $1 trillion next year
summary: JPMorgan CEO Jamie Dimon projects that AI spending by major cloud hyperscalers could reach $1 trillion in the coming year as tech giants continue to boost infrastructure investments. This signals the massive scale of capital commitments being made to artificial intelligence development and deployment.
content: JPMorgan CEO Jamie Dimon says AI spending across the hyperscaler ecosystem could reach $1 trillion next year as investment continues to surge.

zh.title: 摩根大通首席执行官杰米·戴蒙表示超大规模云厂商的AI支出明年可能达到1万亿美元
zh.summary: 摩根大通首席执行官杰米·戴蒙预计，随着科技巨头继续增加基础设施投资，主要云超大规模厂商的AI支出在未来一年可能达到1万亿美元。这表明为人工智能开发和部署所做的资本承诺规模之大。
